scope: Godot-side locked runtime Bundle loader plus build-time contract verification for the Batch 09 armored runtime package.
notes: The Godot loader verifies lock version, Bundle format and schema versions, Bundle filename, file SHA-256, manifest mirrors, resource manifest and exact entity order.
Configuration-specific claims and metrics are retrieved only through an explicit configuration_id; no best or default configuration is chosen automatically.
A Python contract verifier enforces the same file and lock invariants during CI before the data reaches Godot.
The loader resolves integer source references but does not load source documents or interpret gameplay balance.
Current CI statically checks the GDScript contract and function surface; running Godot headless syntax tests remains a later integration step.
